scope.method: polynomial identities, discriminant trapping, finite exact interval

checks.detail: degree-one identity certified at more than two points
degree-two identity certified at more than three points
four-point exact cubic identity at g=67+x

checks.statement: the only square Delta for 3<=g<=66 is at g=6

checks.detail: g=2 is linear; 3..66 exact; g>=67 lies between consecutive squares

checks.statement: the unique admissible odd solution is (2,5)

verdict: The odd-core obstruction has the unique integral zero (g,d)=(2,5). At g=6 its algebraic interference roots are 17/3 and 37/3, so scalar extension creates zeros that the integral constructor lattice excludes.
